message_id.description: Store-assigned on the message event, monotonic per store file, never reused; later events reference it.

sender.description: message events only; derived by the store from the calling scope, never supplied by the caller.

kind.description: message events only. Inbox kinds: the first three and hypothesis_refuted (claim, evidence, plan; appended by refine.hypothesis-refuted, phase-workflows.adoc, Open Hypotheses of Epic Plans) from plans; transfer_offer and intake_confirmed from epics; the operator's acts on a plan of the epic, appended by the server with the act (paused, started, cancelled, abandoned, revised by a chat, settings_changed by a change of the plan's settings; payload: reason, channel, device_id); overlap_found, appended by the server when a running plan's realized changes come to overlap another running plan of the epic beyond the epic's overlap_max_files (payload: plan_id, other_plan_id, files). An overlap of a plan's unplanned changes with a sibling's declared surface found at its landing is noted in the plan's landing record. Mailbox kinds: advisory, spec_amendment, coordination.

payload.description: Kind-specific structured payload (the landing envelope for landing_notification; source_epic, source_plan_id, source_location for transfer_offer; reason, channel (cli or web), and device_id for an operator's act; plan_id, other_plan_id, and files for overlap_found).

by.description: claimed, processed, consumed, annotation: the scope id that appended the event.

outcome.description: processed only: what the consumer did (for example the landing record id or the queue row changed).

note.description: annotation only: a correction referencing the original message, which is never rewritten.
